experiments.title: Learning when historical context worsens attack-stage decisions
experiments.finding: Higher movement recall than ordinary gating, with more false alerts and higher weighted error in all five conditions

experiments.title: Selecting stage evidence under availability and deadline constraints
experiments.finding: Lower simulated spend but no robust detection advantage; some better F1 comparisons suppress attack warnings

experiments.title: Measuring time-split sensitivity in attack-stage classification
experiments.finding: Time-mixed training raises macro-F1 by .0632/.0383 on identical anchor rows; diagnostic, not deployment improvement

experiments.title: Transferring a context-selection score policy between recent security datasets
experiments.finding: Cost-sensitive hard decisions match context in all 42 views; no added decision benefit. Secondary T1105 policy transfer, not movement/exfiltration confirmation

inference_rule: These are exposed-data development studies. Freeze source and protocol before fitting; keep all registered outcomes. Do not infer independent-campaign efficacy, novelty, or a guarantee from a good score.
